display_title: Deploy all prod services before training in release workflow

head_commit.message:
Deploy all prod services before training in release workflow

Restructure cd-release.yml to deploy environment-first instead of
app-first. For releases, all prod services now complete before any
training deploys begin. If any prod deploy fails, training is skipped.

Phase 2 (prod): API → Frontend + Analytics (parallel)
Phase 3 (training, release only): API → Frontend + Analytics (parallel)

For workflow_dispatch with a single environment, behavior is unchanged.

Closes #8654

[Issue #8868] Upgrade python state machine to 3.0 (#8869)

## Summary
Fixes #8868

## Changes proposed
* Upgrades python state machine to version 3.0

## Context for reviewers
This release changed a lot
https://python-statemachine.readthedocs.io/en/latest/releases/3.0.0.html

It includes a ton of features, some of which we might consider using,
but for now, we'll keep things mostly the same. I did have to adjust a
bit of error logic but still checking the same actual things.

Importantly, there are two configurations that we kept as they were that
are defined in the base class. While these are two things that are
making it more like the SCXML specification that it now supports, I
don't think we want them (transition states being null temporarily AND
errors triggering events).

## Validation steps
Tests continue working with a few adjustments to error cases. Wanted to
get this change in before we actually start running everything as that
way we don't need two passes at testing after a major version upgrade.
